items.note: Fix pagination count when a filter matches more than 100 rows
items.text:
Fix pagination count when a filter matches more than 100 rows

On the admin list view the page-2 link is dead whenever a filter narrows to 100+ rows. The count query uses the filtered count but the pager link uses the unfiltered one.

items.note: Webhook retries double-fire when the receiver answers 5xx
items.text:
Webhook retries double-fire when the receiver answers 5xx

The retry worker re-sends the original delivery AND the scheduled retry, so receivers see each failed event twice.

items.note: Intermittent 401 on the OAuth callback right after a deploy
items.text:
Intermittent 401 on the OAuth callback right after a deploy

For ~30s after each deploy the callback route rejects valid state cookies. Smells like a signing-key race between old and new workers.

items.note: Migrate the remaining shortcodes to Eleventy plugins
items.text:
Migrate the remaining shortcodes to Eleventy plugins

Twelve posts still use the old Hugo-style shortcodes. Port the three shortcode types and re-render those posts.

items.note: Backfill alt text on the 40 legacy posts missing it
items.text: Backfill alt text on the 40 legacy posts missing it Accessibility sweep flagged 40 posts with bare tags. Generate alt text from the caption or the surrounding paragraph.

items.note: Add per-tag RSS feeds alongside the main feed
items.text:
Add per-tag RSS feeds alongside the main feed

Readers asked for tag-scoped feeds. One feed per tag, linked from the tag pages.

items.note: Draft: responsive image pipeline with srcset
items.text: Draft: responsive image pipeline with srcset Idea stage. Generate 480/960/1440 variants at build time and rewrite to srcset. Needs a shaping pass before a worker picks it up.
